subject.title: refactor(channels): fix account resolution and setup isolation

question: After a rebase, do maintainers approve adopting the shared plugin-SDK account/setup semantics for the affected bundled channels, including their upgrade behavior for existing root and named account configurations?
rationale: The patch is intentionally broad and changes compatibility-sensitive runtime and onboarding behavior; source-level correctness alone cannot choose the acceptable cross-channel compatibility contract.

options.title: Rebase and approve shared semantics
options.body: Refresh the branch against current main, rerun focused account/setup regressions, and merge if each owner-specific compatibility invariant remains intact.

options.title: Narrow the migration
options.body: Keep only the verified Twitch and scoped credential fixes, leaving other channel migrations on their established local implementations until separately reviewed.

options.title: Pause for per-channel owner review
options.body: Hold the consolidation until owners explicitly confirm the affected account-listing and merge semantics for their channels.

recommendation.title: Rebase and approve shared semantics
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch against current main, rerun focused account/setup regressions, and merge if each owner-specific compatibility invariant remains intact.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR evidence identifies steipete as the implementation owner for the proposed shared contract and channel migrations.
